title: Create a reading test
subtitle: Upload a worksheet page or any photo. AI turns it into passages with questions.
appendTo: New questions will be added to “{{title}}”

upload.heading: Pages or photos
upload.paste: Or paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V
upload.formats: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to {{size}} MB each · up to {{max}} images
upload.tip: A worksheet page becomes the same test; a normal photo becomes a story with questions.
upload.tooMany: You can add up to {{max}} images
upload.badType: {{name}} is not a JPG, PNG or WebP image

prefs.heading: Preferences

modeHelp.auto: AI decides whether each image is a worksheet or a normal photo
modeHelp.worksheet: Rebuild the exercises on the page as the same test
modeHelp.photo: Write a new passage about the picture, then questions on it

prefs.subject: Subject
prefs.crosswordHelp: Built from key words of the passage
prefs.topicPlaceholder: e.g. Focus on the animals in the picture and keep sentences short
prefs.cropRoundsHelp: After cropping a picture from the page, the AI checks the crop and fixes it, up to this many times

needFiles: Add at least one image to start
